x.en: Minutes of strength training per week

peak.en: Most of the benefit at 30–60 min

schem.en: Schematic of the pattern in the studies, not measured values
schem.ru: Схема закономерности из исследований, не измеренные значения

sources.cite: Momma H, et al. Muscle-strengthening activities are associated with lower risk and mortality in major non-communicable diseases: a systematic review and meta-analysis of cohort studies. Br J Sports Med 2022.
sources.note_en: About 10–17% lower risk of death, heart disease, cancer and diabetes; the benefit peaked at 30–60 minutes a week.
sources.note_ru: Риск смерти, болезней сердца, рака и диабета ниже примерно на 10–17%; максимум пользы приходился на 30–60 минут в неделю.

sources.cite: Shailendra P, et al. Resistance training and mortality risk: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Am J Prev Med 2022.
sources.note_en: About 15% lower risk of death; combined with aerobic activity the reduction was largest.
sources.note_ru: Риск смерти ниже примерно на 15%; в сочетании с аэробной нагрузкой снижение было наибольшим.
